title: CVE-2026-123158 added to CISA KEV (exploited in the wild)
summary_en: OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.
lines: OpenBSD OpenSSH: OpenBSD OpenSSH Unexpected Status Code or Return Value Vulnerability
OpenBSD OpenSSH on Linux contains an unexpected status code or return value vulnerability that could allow for authentication bypass.
